opciones.explicacion: packages.yml declares package dependencies, not model config.

opciones.texto_opcion: In dbt_project.yml set `models: my_project: staging: +materialized: view`
opciones.explicacion: Directory-level config in dbt_project.yml applies defaults by folder.

opciones.texto_opcion: Configure materialization in profiles.yml
opciones.explicacion: profiles.yml holds connection profiles, not model materializations.

opciones.texto_opcion: Set materialization inside every .sql file only
opciones.explicacion: Works but duplicates config; folder defaults are cleaner.

pregunta: dbt project review — a platform team publishing shared packages. schema changed on an incremental model; team needs a one-time rebuild. What should the team do? Constraint set #3.

opciones.texto_opcion: Delete dbt_project.yml
opciones.explicacion: Breaks the project.

opciones.texto_opcion: Run `dbt test` only
opciones.explicacion: Tests do not rebuild models.

opciones.texto_opcion: Drop the profile and re-clone the repo
opciones.explicacion: Unrelated to incremental rebuild.

opciones.texto_opcion: Run `dbt run --full-refresh --select <model>`
opciones.explicacion: --full-refresh rebuilds incremental models from scratch once.

pregunta: a legacy model should stay in repo but not run in production. Context: a platform team publishing shared packages. Constraint set #3.

opciones.texto_opcion: Delete the model from git history only locally
opciones.explicacion: Risky; enabled:false is explicit and reversible.

opciones.texto_opcion: Rename the .sql to .bak without config
opciones.explicacion: dbt may still parse depending on layout; config is clearer.

opciones.texto_opcion: Set `enabled: false` in the model config
opciones.explicacion: enabled: false keeps the model out of the DAG without deleting files.

opciones.texto_opcion: Move the model to analyses/
opciones.explicacion: analyses are not materialized but changes model semantics.

pregunta: During `dbt build` troubleshooting in a finance mart with strict SLAs: every model file should document owner and SLA at the top. Select the correct answer. Constraint set #3.

opciones.texto_opcion: Hardcode owner email in warehouse comments manually
opciones.explicacion: Not tied to dbt metadata.

opciones.texto_opcion: Remove all documentation to speed compiles
opciones.explicacion: Hurts governance.

opciones.texto_opcion: Store SLA only in Slack pins
opciones.explicacion: Not version-controlled with the model.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use a Jinja `{{ config(...) }}` block and YAML meta; optional file header comments
opciones.explicacion: Config blocks and schema YAML meta document ownership and SLAs in version control.

pregunta: dbt project review — a medallion lakehouse built with dbt. incremental model must filter new rows using a reliable watermark column. What should the team do? Constraint set #3.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use is_incremental() without referencing {{ this }}
opciones.explicacion: May reprocess all rows or miss logic on self-reference.

opciones.texto_opcion: Disable is_incremental() and append duplicates daily
opciones.explicacion: Creates duplicate rows.

opciones.texto_opcion: Always filter with WHERE updated_at > current_date in full refresh too
opciones.explicacion: Would skip historical rows on first build.

opciones.texto_opcion: Wrap filter logic in `{% if is_incremental() %} WHERE updated_at > (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM {{ this }}) {% endif %}`
opciones.explicacion: is_incremental() gates the filter so full-refresh builds load all history once.

pregunta: For a multi-environment dbt Cloud job with nightly jobs: downstream BI only needs a logical layer; no persisted table is required. Best practice? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Disable materialization in dbt_project.yml
opciones.explicacion: Every model needs an explicit or inherited materialization.

opciones.texto_opcion: materialized='incremental' with no unique key
opciones.explicacion: Incremental without keys is unnecessary when no persistence is needed.

opciones.texto_opcion: Configure `materialized='view'` in the model config
opciones.explicacion: Views compile to warehouse views without storing duplicate data.

opciones.texto_opcion: materialized='table' for every staging model
opciones.explicacion: Tables persist data and add storage/maintenance cost when a view suffices.

pregunta: In a multi-environment dbt Cloud job: a mart must be fully rebuilt nightly and is queried heavily by many dashboards. Which dbt approach is best? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Run manual CREATE TABLE outside dbt
opciones.explicacion: Bypasses dbt lineage, tests, and config.

opciones.texto_opcion: materialized='ephemeral' for the mart
opciones.explicacion: Ephemeral models are inlined CTEs, not queryable relations.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use `materialized='table'` (optionally with `post-hook` grants)
opciones.explicacion: Tables provide fast read performance for frequently accessed marts.

opciones.texto_opcion: Only create a source() stub without a model
opciones.explicacion: Sources reference raw data; marts need model builds.

pregunta: For a medallion lakehouse built with dbt with nightly jobs: a reusable intermediate SELECT should not create a warehouse object. Best practice? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Set `materialized='ephemeral'` so dbt inlines it as a CTE
opciones.explicacion: Ephemeral models reduce clutter and avoid extra table scans when inlined.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use a seed file for the intermediate
opciones.explicacion: Seeds are for static CSV-like data, not transforms.

opciones.texto_opcion: materialized='table' for the intermediate
opciones.explicacion: Creates an unnecessary persisted object.

opciones.texto_opcion: Duplicate the SQL in every downstream model manually
opciones.explicacion: Violates DRY and complicates maintenance.

pregunta: For a monorepo with three dbt projects with nightly jobs: a large fact table receives daily append-only events with billions of rows. Best practice? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Full table rebuild every hour with materialized='table'
opciones.explicacion: Full rebuilds on billions of rows are costly.

opciones.texto_opcion: Skip incremental logic and rely on warehouse caching only
opciones.explicacion: Caching does not replace efficient incremental loads.

opciones.texto_opcion: materialized='view' and scan all history each query
opciones.explicacion: Views recompute full history on every BI query.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use `materialized='incremental'` with an `is_incremental()` filter on event date
opciones.explicacion: Incremental models process only new rows after the initial build.

pregunta: For a medallion lakehouse built with dbt with nightly jobs: new source columns appear frequently; the incremental model should adapt safely. Best practice? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: Drop the table on any new column
opciones.explicacion: Destructive and loses history.

opciones.texto_opcion: Set `on_schema_change: append_new_columns` (or sync) in model config
opciones.explicacion: on_schema_change controls how dbt handles new/changed columns during incremental runs.

opciones.texto_opcion: Disable incremental and always full-refresh silently
opciones.explicacion: Expensive and hides config intent.

opciones.texto_opcion: Ignore schema drift and fail every run
opciones.explicacion: Brittle; append/sync handles additive changes.

pregunta: In a finance mart with strict SLAs: BigQuery queries filter on `event_date` and `country_code` constantly. Which dbt approach is best? Constraint set #4.

opciones.texto_opcion: No partitioning or clustering on a multi-TB fact
opciones.explicacion: Full scans increase cost and latency.

opciones.texto_opcion: Configure `cluster_by: ['event_date', 'country_code']` in the model config
opciones.explicacion: cluster_by (BigQuery) or similar layout hints improve prune-friendly scans.

opciones.texto_opcion: Hardcode LIMIT 1000 in the model SQL
opciones.explicacion: Truncates data; not a layout optimization.

opciones.texto_opcion: Use seeds instead of the fact model
opciones.explicacion: Seeds cannot replace large fact pipelines.
